limitations: One synthetic contiguous T512 invocation and one seed; no training, backward, optimizer step or checkpoint.
No actual data, quality, throughput, energy or resource-speed claim.
Local GDN comparison is same-input FP32; full-model BF16/FP32 comparisons include propagation through different recurrence/routing states.
Teacher-forced routes are a diagnostic intervention, not production routing and not an exact-equivalence claim.
Route-flip timing is observational; it does not by itself identify the first causal numerical origin.

candidate_hypothesis.text: Same-input FP32 GDN comparisons are the local contraction-order control; the full-model BF16 comparison includes recurrence, BF16 boundary casts and sparse routing. First top2 route-set mismatch is at block 2, logical pass 1, with 3 of 512 valid positions. Teacher-forced scan-selected routes changed the maximum logits rel-L2 from 0.0322755 to 0.00859061 (ratio 0.266); this is an intervention result, not proof of a first cause.

fixed_route.claim_limit: teacher-forced diagnostic only; not production routing and not an exact-equivalence claim

propagation.state_note: The no-cache forward supplies zero GDN prefix state at each logical pass, so the state-input difference is zero at pass 2; within-pass final-state divergence is reported under delta_final.
